description: Council skip permit rules for placing a skip on a public road: fee, permit period, notice needed, renewal, application link, last-verified date and data confidence. Provide exactly one of council_name or town_slug. A skip on a private driveway needs no permit.

council_name.description: Highways authority name, case-insensitive, for example "Kent" or "Wiltshire Council".

town_slug.description: Rent-a-Skip town slug, for example "westbury" or "milton-keynes". Use check_coverage to find one.

name: get_permit_info
title: Skip permit rules
